extensionDescription.message: A browser extension that overlays Pinyin or Zhuyin annotations on Chinese characters in web pages and video subtitles.

statusNotAnnotated.description: Popup status: page is not annotated.

statusRestrictedTitle.description: Popup alert title for restricted pages.

statusRestrictedDesc.message: Browser extensions cannot run on this type of page (e.g. browser internal pages, extension stores).
statusRestrictedDesc.description: Popup alert description for restricted pages.

statusRefreshTitle.description: Popup alert title when a refresh is needed.

statusRefreshDesc.message: This tab was opened before the extension was installed or updated. Please refresh the page to activate.
statusRefreshDesc.description: Popup alert description when a refresh is needed.

statusRefreshAction.description: Button to refresh the current tab.

annotationScaleTogether.description: Popup: scale mode hint when text scales together with annotation.

annotationScaleOnly.description: Popup: scale mode hint when only the annotation scales.

scaleTextTogether.description: Popup: checkbox label to scale text with the annotation.

selectedTextLabel.description: Popup: divider label above the selected text preview.

optionsWritingSystemDesc.message: Pinyin uses letters you can type. Zhuyin uses symbols used in Taiwan.

optionsToneMarksDesc.message: Show tone marks (ā á ǎ à) instead of no tones.

optionsPlacementDescRight.description: Options: placement description when right side is selected.

optionsPlacementDescOver.description: Options: placement description when above/below is selected.

optionsAutoAnnotateDesc.message: Automatically annotate whenever you open a new page.

optionsFollowChangesDesc.message: Update annotations when the page or the captions change. Turn it off only if a site misbehaves.

optionsWordLookupDesc.message: Click a word in the popup to open a dictionary.

optionsUrlPattern.description: Options: custom dictionary URL pattern label.

optionsUrlPatternDesc.message: {word} will be replaced with the selected text.
optionsUrlPatternDesc.description: Options: custom dictionary URL pattern description.

optionsUrlPatternPlaceholder.description: Options: custom dictionary URL pattern placeholder.

optionsThemeDesc.message: Match your system, or pick light or dark.

optionsShortcutDesc.message: to toggle annotations on any page.

optionsSkipDesc.message: HTML tags to skip when annotating. Comma-separated, uppercase.

optionsReportBug.description: Options: report a bug footer link.

optionsFooterCopyright.description: Options: footer copyright, $1 is the year.

optionsPreviewTextAndAnnotation.description: Options: preview meta, text scales with annotation.

optionsPreviewAnnotationOnly.description: Options: preview meta, only annotation scales.

shortcutChangeInstructions.message: Open about:addons → Gear → Manage Extension Shortcuts
shortcutChangeInstructions.description: Options: alert instructions when shortcut settings cannot be opened.

followChangesTooltip.message: Keeps annotations up to date when a page — or a video's captions — changes. It is what makes subtitles follow along.
followChangesTooltip.description: Popup: tooltip on an option row.

autoAnnotateTooltip.message: Automatically annotate pinyin on every page load.
autoAnnotateTooltip.description: Popup: tooltip on an option row.

optionsLanguageDesc.message: Choose the language for the extension interface.
